About Us
SONAPUR COLLEGE (AUTONOMOUS)
Sonapur College, accredited with NAAC A+ Grade in its 3rd cycle of assessment is now in its 33rd year of glorious existence. Established in the year 1991 with the efforts of a group of socially committed individuals, Sonapur College has been imparting value-based education. The College endeavours to build an atmosphere for pursuit of academic excellence along with the holistic development of its student community. Students of the college enjoy an easy access to faculty guidance, full staff support, and constant monitoring and supervision at every level of their academic pursuits.The college provides students with a range of opportunities for self-expression, taking initiatives and experimentation in intellectual and co-curricular fields.
As a centre of academic excellence in the entire North East, the aim of the college is to nurture simultaneous academic and co-curricular endeavor. Since its inception, Sonapur College, from its nascent stage to a centre of academic excellence, has proved to be a meeting point for students from diverse ethnic and linguistic backgrounds of the region and beyond.
The College apart from education also intends to foster a spirit of academic excellence with the belief that value-based learning is of great relevance in a dynamic work environment. Students of the college enjoy an easy access to faculty guidance, full staff support, and constant monitoring and supervision at every level of their achieving excellence in their academic pursuits. The college provides students with a range of avenues and opportunities for self-expression, initiative and experimentation in both the intellectual and co-curricular fields.

Our Facilities
Barrier-Free & Student-Centric Campus Facilities
College Library
The well furnished library of Sonapur College provides the facility of a spacious reading room where a large number of students can read at a time.
Sports Facilities
Sonapur College is dedicated to the physical well-being of its students, offering a range of facilities designed to foster athletic talent and fitness. The campus features a spacious multipurpose playground suitable for football and cricket, alongside dedicated courts for volleyball.
Facilities for the differently abled persons
Ramp facilities throughout the buildings, a ramp connecting two RCC academic buildings up to the 3rd floor, wheelchair availability, and dedicated differently-abled toilets
Student Common Room
The college maintains separate common rooms for boys and girls. Boys’ room revives the traditional Tiwa Dekachang (Chamadi) as a cultural youth space. Girls’ room offers indoor games, magazines, and periodicals for recreation.
